test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: I, J, K, L, M, N and O are sitting along a circle facing at the centre and are playing cards. M is the immediate neighbour of I and L. J is second to the left of O. N is on the immediate right of I. What is the position of N?

options.text: To the immediate left of J

solution:
I, J, K, L, M, N and O are sitting along a circle facing at the centre.

1) J is second to the left of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb8bb30d8dc387c63c7149d2c6d7ea8a9638a12da6da0844b3824eea20c4ac72.png] 

2) M is the immediate neighbour of I and L.

3) N is on the immediate right of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcbab0f4a28de946a11428d0295b1831cc96a5ed29cb579707f2eba51d98311b.png] 

N is to the **immediate left of J.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"To the immediate left of J "**
